notes: Audited against data/bill-text/119-HR-3872.txt = H.R. 3872 Engrossed in House (EH), Passed the House December 15, 2025. Single-section amendment to the Mineral Leasing Act for Acquired Lands (30 U.S.C. 351, 352): restructures the Section 2 definitions and adds a new 'hardrock mineral' definition (includes: minerals in sedimentary/other rocks, base metals, precious metals, industrial minerals, precious/semi-precious gemstones; excludes: coal, oil, oil shale, gas, sodium, potassium, sulfur, Materials Act of 1947 minerals), and amends Section 3 to add hardrock minerals to the covered minerals. Every bill-content claim is source-supported with zero material or direction errors. Only open rows are minor: likelihoodReason metadata/framing not present in the Engrossed text (sponsor, cosponsor count, Senate ENR committee action, 'bipartisan appeal on supply-chain grounds', 'needs Senate floor time') - Zone-3/structural context per rubric class 8.
